tools.description: List all distinct service names that have sent telemetry to SOBS. Useful as a first step to discover what services are being observed.
tools.name: list_services

tools.description: Query the otel_logs table.  Returns log records matching the given filters.  Useful for diagnosing application errors, warning events, and general operational log data.

from_ts.description: Start of the time window as an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2024-01-15T10:00:00Z).  Defaults to 1 hour ago.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–500, default 100).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring search applied to the Body field.

severity.description: Filter by SeverityText, e.g. ERROR, WARN, INFO.

to_ts.description: End of the time window as an ISO-8601 timestamp.  Defaults to now.

tools.name: query_otel_logs

tools.description: Query the otel_traces table for distributed trace spans. Useful for performance analysis, error tracing, and understanding service dependencies.

from_ts.description: Start of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to 1 hour ago.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–500, default 100).

to_ts.description: End of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to now.

tools.name: query_otel_traces

tools.description: Query the v_otel_metrics_1m pre-aggregated 1-minute metrics view. Returns average values and sample counts for the requested metric(s). Useful for understanding service health and performance trends.

from_ts.description: Start of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to 1 hour ago.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000, default 200).

metric_kind.description: Filter by MetricKind: gauge, sum, or histogram.

to_ts.description: End of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to now.

tools.name: query_metrics

tools.description: Query raw metric data points from otel_metrics_gauge, otel_metrics_sum, or otel_metrics_histogram tables. Useful when you need individual data points rather than pre-aggregated 1-minute rollups.

from_ts.description: Start of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to 1 hour ago.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–500, default 100).

metric_kind.description: The table to query: gauge, sum, or histogram.  Required.

to_ts.description: End of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to now.

tools.name: query_metrics_raw

tools.description: Return a list of all distinct metric names currently stored in SOBS along with the last seen timestamp and the service that reported them. Useful for discovering which metrics are available to query.
tools.name: get_metric_names

tools.description: Return the list of configured anomaly detection rules in SOBS. Useful for understanding which metrics are being monitored for anomalies and what the configured thresholds are.
tools.name: get_anomaly_rules

tools.description: Return recent error-level log events and error-status trace spans. Useful for quickly surfacing recent failures across all services.

from_ts.description: Start of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to 1 hour ago.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–200, default 50).

to_ts.description: End of the time window (ISO-8601).  Defaults to now.

tools.name: get_recent_errors
